name: live_kill_xp_karma
description: The host hits Sunny Smiles (very good karma, in a crime-tracking faction) and the guest then kills her. The guest is the killer: the host pays the guest's own shadow experience, and the kill's karma (fKarmaModMurderingVeryGoodNPC, -100) is paid once, for the killer's kill. Karma is one value for the party, so every peer reads karma -100 from its own game state.
